recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆巨大組織球，細胞質充滿均一的小空泡、呈淡藍灰色泡沫狀（桑葚或肥皂泡樣），核小而卵圓，體積遠大於周圍造血細胞，是 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞的典型樣貌。
features: Very large histiocyte, many times the size of adjacent neutrophils and red cells
Low N:C ratio with a single small oval nucleus and fine chromatin
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm filled with uniform small clear vacuoles (foamy/mulberry appearance)
Background normal hematopoietic cells: metamyelocyte/band, myelocyte, lymphocytes, erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large histiocyte with a single small oval nucleus and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm uniformly packed with small, clear, round vacuoles, giving a foamy or mulberry appearance. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary striations of Gaucher cells. Surrounding hematopoietic cells appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a lipid-laden foam cell (Niemann-Pick cell), compatible with Niemann-Pick disease in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation by acid sphingomyelinase activity or NPC1/NPC2 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than uniform round vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, although they can coexist with foam cells in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Foamy macrophages in hyperlipidemia or TPN/lipid infusion
ddx.vs: Secondary lipid-laden macrophages are fewer, occur with a clinical lipid source, and enzyme studies are normal.
MAC-laden histiocytes show faint striated negative images of bacilli and are strongly AFB positive.
